1539.inventory: PreparationTicket already derives serde and equality; residency records derive Default and input identity derives PartialEq. ProductAccess implements Deref and DerefMut by matching Active/Staged selection and indexing owner-specific MutexGuard state. Other inherent functions check tickets/input identities, stage/activate/cancel retained products and preserve sequence.
1539.disposition: Keep both manual dereference impls: neither forwards a single field, both borrow through guard and dynamic variant-selected owner storage, including mutable exclusive access. Derive forwarding would change target/semantics. No other mechanical codec/trait body.
